Title: Authenticated IP for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now in preview

Body.Content:
Authenticated IP in AKS allows organizations to restrict access to their Kubernetes control plane to specific IP addresses or IP ranges. This provides an additional layer of security by restricting access to only trusted network locations. This feature is available now in public preview.

Learn more
